I would just like your general thoughts on what's with the latest developments with this and what your thoughts are on this.

My concern is that a skirmish or a small battle could lead to an escalation and a full blown war. I think the one lesson from the Iraq war was that regime change doesn't work in the Middle East. You get rid of one strong man, and that strong man is replaced by another strong man. But in between the two strong men comes chaos, and in chaos becomes a breeding ground for terrorism. When they topple Qaddafi and Libya, we had chaos, and we still have terrorists breeding there, and we still have civil war eight years later now. When we topple Hussein and Iraq, guess what? We had chaos, more terrorism, ISIS arose than Iraq. And guess what? Who's Iraq's best friend now? Who's their best ally? Iran. So by toppling the regime in Iraq, we actually destabilized the Middle East and led to an imbalance of power where Iran is actually much stronger than they were before we toppled Hussein. So I think the rule of thumb is we need to not always get involved in every damn civil war around the world. And frankly, I'm not for sending your kid or my kid to any of these wars right now. I don't see an American interest in any of them.
